note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. "Has been returned unopposed"; printed "T. S. Hardy" (Thomas H. Hardy stood for Richhill in 1902). Described in the nominations as: T. S. Hardy, J.P. (anti-direct labour).
